notes.title: Shotgun Colossus Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Hello there,

It seems as though some players were experiencing a game crashing bug on the Shotgun Colossus, which we have now attempted to fix. Having this bug hinder players progress was not our intention, and we apologise for any undue frustrations this may have caused. 

And thank you for having communicated this bug with us! We're a pretty small fish with limited resources, so letting us know about these things is invaluable!

With kind regards,

Planetary Gears

notes.title: First Early Access Update!
notes.notes:
Hello Dear Friends,

We've listened to your feedback and made improvements!

For starters, we've added one new gun, one new engine and a new wing to the game, taking the possible player combinations to... 7 x 7 x 7 ... carry the 2... add 3... A whole boat load of possible combinations to mix and match and find a one that suits you!

We've also added the new Sniper colossus, for you to challenge, defeat and get some of those sweet sweet permanent multipliers.

Other improvements that we have made:
- Tweaked the balancing to make more combinations and play styles viable.
- Added some much needed gameplay UI for Health and Power readouts.
- Added more diverse and interesting challenges.
- Tweaked the Menu UI to be more communicative.
- Added a bit of subtle visual flair.
- Improved the combo streak system.
- Optimised things for a smoother experience.
- Fixed some small visual bugs.

Thank you to everyone who gave their feedback while we still work on developing th game further.

Now is the perfect time to hop back in or experience a better version of Opollo for the first time thanks to your guy's feedback.

Spread the good news!

We hope you have a nice time with Opollo and have fun defeating the Colossi!

With kind regards,

Planetary Gears
